title: HARMEAN stores each x87 reciprocal, running reciprocal sum, count quotient, and final reciprocal
statement: In Excel 16.0 build 20430, HARMEAN rejects any input <= 0 with #NUM!, accumulates reciprocal_sum via stored x87 RN53(RN64(1 / v)) and RN53(RN64(sum + recip)), rejects nonfinite reciprocal sums with #NUM!, divides by n in stored x87, and takes the stored x87 reciprocal of that average. All 19,214 full-bank HARMEAN rows match.
basis: Measured in CalcFunc-Evidence runs/w111-aggregate-rounding-discovery-20260929/answers-harmean.json.gz (Excel 16.0 build 20430) and matched on 19,214/19,214 full-bank HARMEAN rows.
inferred: That every arbitrary-length input list follows the same four stored x87 boundaries beyond the 19,214 bank rows is inferred.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0 build 20430, Windows 64-bit, workbook compatibility 2; CPU not recorded

evidence.note: stored x87 reciprocals, sum, quotient, and final reciprocal
